name: priority:P0
description: Critical correctness or current Home Assistant compatibility work.

name: priority:P1
description: Required for the next planned minor release.

name: priority:P2
description: Valuable work that does not block the primary user journey.

name: priority:P3
description: Nice-to-have, experimental, or primarily visual improvement.

name: type:bug
description: A reproducible defect in existing behavior.

name: type:feature
description: A new user-facing capability or behavior.

name: type:refactor
description: Internal restructuring without an intended behavior change.

name: type:test
description: Test coverage, fixtures, or verification infrastructure.

name: type:docs
description: Documentation-only work.

name: type:chore
description: Repository maintenance, dependencies, or operational work.

name: area:runtime
description: Rendering lifecycle, reactivity, state updates, or Lit runtime.

name: area:entities
description: Entity resolution, registry metadata, values, or formatting.

name: area:controls
description: Buttons, selectors, dropdowns, and service execution.

name: area:actions
description: Lovelace tap, hold, double-tap, confirmation, or navigation actions.

name: area:layout
description: Responsive layout, Sections grid behavior, rows, or styling.

name: area:editor
description: Visual editor, selectors, schemas, or configuration UX.

name: area:compatibility
description: Home Assistant version or integration compatibility.

name: area:vendor
description: Vendor- or model-specific compatibility profile work.

name: area:ci-release
description: CI, HACS validation, dependencies, release, or publishing.

name: area:testing
description: Test harnesses, fixtures, browser or HA tests, and quality gates.

name: status:needs-info
description: Required environment, configuration, or diagnostics are missing.

name: status:needs-reproduction
description: The reported behavior has not yet been reproduced.

name: status:blocked
description: Progress is blocked by a documented dependency or external change.

name: epic
description: Parent issue that tracks a multi-issue outcome.

name: source:upstream
description: Derived from historical upstream issues or pull requests.

name: breaking-change
description: May require a configuration migration or incompatible behavior change.

name: good first issue
description: Suitable for a contributor new to this repository.

name: help wanted
description: Maintainers would value community implementation or device evidence.
